document: Member 3 vehicle-level inputs required for a range estimate
warning: No value in this file is a measured or approved input. The repository contains no vehicle configuration with verified provenance. Do not treat the absence of a value as a default and do not invent one.
energy_conversion_rule: Member 2 returns cell-level capacity in Ah. Cell Ah must never be converted to vehicle pack kWh by this project's interface. Pack energy and the usable-energy fraction are Member 3 inputs.
road_grade_assumption: A flat-road (grade = 0) assumption must be documented by Member 3 when no measured grade profile is available.

required_inputs.name: vehicle_identity
required_inputs.source_required: Vehicle make/model/year, or a clearly labelled representative vehicle
required_inputs.notes: The label must state whether the vehicle is the actual target vehicle or a representative proxy.

required_inputs.name: pack_nominal_energy_kwh
required_inputs.source_required: OEM specification or measured pack data with citation
required_inputs.notes: Pack-level quantity. Not derivable from Member 2 cell Ah without a verified pack topology and series/parallel configuration.

required_inputs.name: pack_usable_energy_kwh
required_inputs.source_required: OEM usable-window specification or measured usable energy with citation
required_inputs.notes: Provide this or provide pack_nominal_energy_kwh plus a justified usable_energy_fraction.

required_inputs.name: usable_energy_fraction
required_inputs.source_required: Justification for the usable window (e.g. OEM buffer specification)
required_inputs.notes: An assumed fraction is a scenario assumption, not a measured value.

required_inputs.name: mass_kg
required_inputs.notes: State whether the mass includes driver/payload.

required_inputs.name: rolling_resistance_coefficient
required_inputs.source_required: Published or measured coefficient with road/tire conditions

required_inputs.name: drivetrain_efficiency
required_inputs.source_required: Reference efficiency map or documented scenario value

required_inputs.name: regenerative_braking_assumption
required_inputs.notes: Must state whether regeneration is included in the consumption model.

required_inputs.name: drive_cycle_time_s
required_inputs.source_required: Official/source-attributed cycle (e.g. WLTC, CLTC, EPA) with citation

required_inputs.name: drive_cycle_speed_mps
required_inputs.notes: Convert published km/h values explicitly; do not mix units.

required_inputs.name: road_grade
required_inputs.notes: If absent, document the flat-road assumption.

required_inputs.name: ambient_c
required_inputs.source_required: Measured ambient value or explicitly documented scenario
required_inputs.notes: Passed to the provisional RangeCalculator.estimate(ambient_c=...) argument. Member 2 does not supply it.

required_inputs.name: hvac_power_kw
required_inputs.source_required: Measured HVAC load or explicitly documented scenario
required_inputs.notes: Passed to the provisional RangeCalculator.estimate(hvac_power_kw=...) argument. Member 2 does not supply it.

required_inputs.name: auxiliary_power_kw
required_inputs.notes: Include only if the range model accounts for non-HVAC auxiliary loads.

required_inputs.name: validation_consumption_kwh_per_km
required_inputs.source_required: Published or measured vehicle consumption under a comparable cycle
required_inputs.notes: Needed to validate the modelled range; absence keeps range estimates unvalidated.

required_inputs.name: validation_range_km
required_inputs.source_required: Published or measured range under a comparable cycle and conditions
required_inputs.notes: Needed to validate the modelled range; absence keeps range estimates unvalidated.
